lastText: Command TerminatedThe Pattern, NoticedMajor DefeatWehrmacht High Command, 1940 — 1945End of hostilities: PATTERN NOTICED — filed late, out of sequenceImmediate AftermathThis ████████ ends here, and not on any front. Führer Mode's █████████ capital was █████ the actual danger — spending it was the mechanic ███████ exactly as intended. The danger was always the pattern underneath the spending: an officer whose file shows this much accumulated independence, however each individual act was justified at the time, is not an officer this regime lets keep a ███████. There is no single order, no ██████ ███████, that did this. There is only the sum of them, noticed all at once, the way these things were in truth noticed. The war █████████ under whoever replaces you. It does not pause to explain the replacement.One Year LaterThe war this command no longer ran ends the way it was always going to: in unconditional surrender, under whoever inherited the file. A year on, the tribunal now sitting at █████████ has no seat reserved for an officer ███████ from command before the end — █████████ was not a ███████ the court recognized for the men who did stay, and it is unlikely to have ███████ for much in the version of events this branch didn't get to see either.Continental Situation — the Europe this war madeContinental Situation — End of 1945 · Theater Map19391945Theater status board, end of 1945.
